scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --external:electron --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/preload.js && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && vite build && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.pack:mac: npm run build && vite build && electron-builder --mac
